children: BW Businessworld’s 9th Sustainable World Conclave will bring together corporate leaders, policymakers and climate-tech founders to examine how sustainability can translate into measurable business value

Mumbai, 16 September 2026: BW Businessworld will host the 9th edition of the Sustainable World Conclave on 17 September 2026 at Novotel, Andheri, Mumbai, bringing together corporate sustainability leaders, policymakers, climate-tech founders and industry experts under the theme “From Ambition to Advantage.” The conclave will focus on how Indian enterprises are moving sustainability commitments beyond statements of intent towards measurable business value. The day-long event will open with an address by Dr Annurag Batra, Chairman & Editor-in-Chief, BW Businessworld and Founder, Exchange4Media, on “Sustainability Beyond Action”. Discussions during the conclave will examine the role of data, capital, supply chains and emerging approaches in corporate sustainability.

The first flagship panel, “AI for Sustainability: Can We Trust the Data Enough to Act on It?”, will bring together sustainability leaders from Reliance Industries, TÜV SÜD AG, Axis Bank, Cipla and Infosys.

The discussion will examine AI applications across energy, operations and ESG reporting, while exploring what is required to move from pilot projects to enterprise-wide deployment. Another session, “Climate Tech at Scale: What Does India Inc. Need Beyond the Pilot?”, will feature leaders from ICICI Bank, Voltas, Dalmia Bharat and HCLTech. The panel will explore why climate-tech pilots can struggle to progress towards procurement and the evidence enterprises need before committing to deployment at scale.

The conclave will also examine the relationship between sustainability, cost and supply-chain resilience. Leaders from TVS Motors, Colgate-Palmolive India and Persistent Systems will discuss whether resilient and low-carbon supply chains can reduce long-term cost and risk.

The final flagship panel, “What Comes After Net Zero? The Next Corporate Sustainability Frontier”, will feature sustainability chiefs from JK Organisation, Aditya Birla Group, Godrej Industries Group and Siemens. The discussion will look beyond carbon towards water, biodiversity, resource security and circularity as emerging material risks for businesses. The programme will additionally feature a fireside conversation between Prabodha Acharya, Chief Sustainability Officer, JSW Group, and Noor Fatima Warsia, Group Editorial Director, BW Businessworld, on corporate accountability for value-chain emissions.

Industry case studies from Mahindra Group and Hindalco Industries will focus on decarbonisation at scale. The conclave will also feature a Startup Spotlight showcasing Flytta Green, ParyAI Solutions, Varaha, Promethean Energy and Indra, with solutions spanning fleet electrification, water treatment, carbon removal and industrial energy efficiency. The event will conclude with a keynote by Deepak Thakur, MD & CEO, Hinduja Renewables, followed by the BW Sustainable World Awards 2026 and a celebratory dinner.
